record.title: Recover the complete mode-zero ADC parameter software contract
record.intent: Recover a typed operation graph through SetADCParameter zero and its callees using immutable stock bytes and observed entry data.
requirements: Pin stock ELF and existing disassembly provenance plus the accepted loader entry and terminal captures; distinguish live zero record evidence from physical calibration semantics.

Recover the complete mode-zero path through return including transitive helpers such as SetAdcStary, call ordering, record offsets widths signedness, immutable tables, loop bounds, arithmetic, masks, shifts, delays, and return-use or error propagation.
Resolve direct calls and relevant relocation bindings from ELF bytes; identify unresolved indirect or runtime selectors explicitly rather than assuming graph completeness.

Produce project-authored TOML operation graph and reproducible typed Kotlin extraction or checking tooling with exact byte ranges and hashes; preserve source artifacts and do not launch a guest or change an observer model.

Classify operations as static-determined runtime-selected hardware-returned asynchronous or unknown; distinguish complete software formulas from absent FPGA semantics and list the smallest unresolved input boundary.

Evaluate formulas under the observed zero ADC record only where all other required inputs are known; preserve live shadows and unobserved globals as parameters rather than inventing values or claiming a validated hardware transcript.
acceptance: An auditable whole-subsystem static contract with explicit completeness limits and unresolved boundaries is committed and pushed.
